agree: All 9 crosswalk links for CIP 42.0101 resolve to O*NET 31.0 occupation codes (tests check this).
Entry targets are O*NET Job Zone 4 linked occupations: Social Science Research Assistants.

Entry targets were reviewed for plausibility and kept: Only one bachelor's-level (Job Zone 4) non-manager occupation is linked (Social Science Research Assistants); psychologist roles are Job Zone 5 and appear as graduate paths.

improve: Knowledge and skill importance is an unweighted mean over all linked occupations, so leadership and faculty roles still shape the top-knowledge list.

still_need_test: Practice prompts, rubrics and reference answer outlines are AI-authored and have not been piloted with learners, scored by human graders, or human-reviewed.
Regression evidence compares this build with the previous release (8cc1ce1) on links, targets, task citations and O*NET text leakage; it does not measure learning outcomes.
No sandbox, benchmark or holdout evaluation exists: this box has no independent model API key or human graders, and a self-graded run would not be independent evidence.
DreamCo-original text has not had owner review.
